GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.5 (1 Dec 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 377)
1 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Rescission of Reports on Repatriation.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Radio message number ZA 6361 to Imperial Japanese Government, dated 1 October 1945, directing submission of a weekly report on repatriation of Japanese nationals.
b. Memorandum for Imperial Japanese Government file as above, dated 17 November 1945, subject: "Repatriation of Non-Japanese from Japan."
2. The weekly reports of repatriation called for in references cited in paragraphs 1a and 1b above are no longer required.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
